aventosCad.source: Blum E-SERVICES, Búsqueda individual de producto, STEP MEDIO
aventosCad.processing: Open CASCADE triangulation and Meshopt compression. Three.js animates the six-piece mechanism using the STEP pin centers, with the front opening to 107°. The showroom uses a reference configuration.

servoDriveCad.source: Blum E-SERVICES, Búsqueda individual de producto, STEP MEDIO
servoDriveCad.processing: Open CASCADE triangulation and Meshopt compression. The simplified STEP faces are grouped into the drive housing, the lever and the stages of each runner. Three.js simulates the lever and extension. The wood drawer, cabinet and support profile are built for the showroom.

spaceTowerCad.source: Blum E-SERVICES, Configurador de productos, Recopilación (3D), STEP MEDIO
spaceTowerCad.configuration: 562 mm clear width, 1990 mm cabinet height, 500 mm nominal runner length, LEGRABOX special edition Noble Rust, four C drawers with low Blum inserts and one low drawer, four nickel-plated screw-on CLIP top BLUMOTION hinges.
spaceTowerCad.processing: Open CASCADE triangulation and Meshopt compression of the official assembly, grouped by door, hinge components, fixed guides, sliding components and five drawers. The individual hinge STEP verifies the seven component identities. Web materials and movement are authored in the showroom.
